name: Ane ni Onna da to Baretara Owaru no de Soshishimasu!!
original_name: 姉に女だとバレたら終わるので阻止します！！
source:
"If I get found out, it's all over."

Yomi lives with her older sister, who believes Yomi is her "younger brother." But in reality, she's a girl.

Living with the sister she so adores is fraught with danger, from changing clothes to bath time!

She absolutely must not let the secret slip.

A visual novel revolving around memories and guilt, starting as a comedy about a siscon girl.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13824]Novelgame[/url]]
